title: Give-and-Go Chair Cut
description: A passer feeds a teammate then pushes hard toward the basket expecting the return pass, the simplest two-player read in wheelchair team offense.

content.objective: Pass and immediately push hard toward the rim, expecting the ball right back.
content.setup: A passer starts at the top of the key, a wing player stands at the left wing.
instructions: Pass to the wing player and immediately push hard toward the basket.
The wing player catches, pivots, and times the return pass to the cutter's path.
The cutter finishes a lay-up off the return pass.
Rotate: the cutter becomes the next passer at the top.
coachingPoints: Push immediately after the pass — don't watch it travel.
Cut hard and change the pushing rhythm to create separation.
The wing player should lead the return pass to where the cutter is going.
commonMistakes: Standing and admiring the first pass instead of cutting.
Cutting too wide instead of pushing straight toward the rim.
Sitting still after a pass instead of moving with purpose.
content.safety: Keep the landing area under the rim clear between reps.
